wrap_jit_function_with_chexify: wrap a jax jit function with chexify to enable runtime value assertions on tensors
use_chexify_with_custom_error_categories: use chexify with ChexifyChecks.float to enable NaN and div-by-zero checks in a jitted function
block_until_chexify_assertions_complete: call block_until_chexify_assertions_complete to wait for all asynchronous chexify checks to finish
use_with_jittable_assertions_alias: use with_jittable_assertions as an alias for chexify to wrap a jitted function with assertions
call_wait_checks_on_chexified_function: call wait_checks on a chexified function to block until its async checks complete
